source: Smithers modules the platform split refused because a platform-using export was an arrow with an inferred return type: build/examples digest-npmrc.ts (async, resolves with a value from another module), src/NodeControl.ts layerServer (returns a type built from a builtin's type, takes an exported options interface) and a generic reader whose type parameter its arguments do not fix. .smithers/flows/invoke/host.ts layer, whose inferred return reads a type the module keeps private, so the sibling's copy must be exported for the module's declarations to name it. Minimized; shapes kept.
